main_body: A flat sand-coloured ground patch (about 48x16 px, 4x3 tile layout) with speckled tan texture, a small grey stone and a small pink flower
top_band: none - flat terrain surface with no top/front structure; the column scan shows only speckle variation between #e2c584, #f1dca2 and #c9a666
evidence: Terrain ground patch (sand). It is a flat ground texture, not a standing object, so the top/front contract does not apply. Column scans show only speckle noise of similar lightness (L 169-220) with no top band, step or front face. Kind terrain matches a ground patch.

style.evidence: Candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 3 colours per tile, against 26 per tile (80 colours) for the grass reference and 7 for paving. The sand has three tones (base, light speckle, dark speckle), which is shallow next to the grass ramp of about 5 steps. The speckles are sparse single pixels and short dashes, with no clumps or grain variation. The small stone and flower add little. There are no 5x5 flat fills (0%), but the texture is thin and sparse compared with the grass, so overall it is clearly lower in density than the references.
